The following are several common Linux commands with a brief description of each listed on
the right.
Drag a command on the left to its appropriate description on the right.
Retrieves content from an HTTP server.
wget
Displays the contents of a directory.
ls
Displays the content of a file.
cat
Copies a file or directory.
cp
Creates an empty file.
touch
Explanation
The following are the appropriate descriptions for each of the listed Linux commands:
cat: Displays the content of a file.
touch: Creates an empty file.
ls: Displays the contents of a directory.
cp: Copies a file or directory.
wget: Retrieves content form an HTTP server.
Question 1 Incorrect
10/17/26, 6:21 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 1/10
A software development company has concerns about the potential risks associated with
insecure design in one of its new applications.
Which of the following controls should a security expert recommend to mitigate these risks?
A
Adopting a security development life cycle (SDLC)
approach
Correct
B Employing Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR)
C Implementing regular security audits
D Applying Content Security Policy (CSP)
Explanation
An SDLC approach ensures that the expert considers and integrates security throughout the entire
software development process. It helps identify and mitigate potential risks associated with insecure
design early in development.
Security audits are essential to maintaining a secure environment but do not directly address insecure
design issues in the development process.
CSP is a security feature that helps prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) and other code injection attacks but
does not specifically address insecure design in software development.
ASLR is a security technique that helps protect against memory-based attacks but does not directly
address insecure design issues in the development process.
Question 2 Incorrect
10/17/26, 6:21 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 2/10
A software development company is building a custom application for a client that will collect
and analyze large amounts of data to identify patterns and make predictions. The client has
specified that the application must use a programming language with many libraries and
tools for machine learning.
Which programming language should the software developer use?
A JavaScript
B C++
C Python Correct
D Java
Explanation
Python has a vast and well-established ecosystem for machine learning, with numerous libraries and
tools available for tasks such as data analysis, visualization, and modeling.
While C++ has some libraries and tools for machine learning, it is less versatile than the ecosystem in
Python.
While Java does have some libraries and tools for machine learning, it is not as well-suited for dataintensive applications as other programming languages, such as Python or R.
JavaScript is a widely-used programming language commonly used for building web applications and
unsuitable for machine learning development.
Question 3 Incorrect
10/17/26, 6:21 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 3/10
A defense contractor discovered that a competitor duplicated some of their products. While
the contractor is afraid of losing revenue, the more significant concern is how the competitor
was able to duplicate the product.
What term describes how this situation occurred?
A Reverse engineering Correct
B Internal scan
C External scan
D Fuzzing
Explanation
Using reverse engineering, a competitor can deconstruct software and/or hardware to determine how it
functions. Reverse engineering aims to determine how much information is extractable from delivered
software.
Internal scans are also important to protect systems from abuse from internal threats and to provide
layered security. A scan would not necessarily allow a competitor to steal intellectual property.
Fuzzing is an unknown environment testing method of purposely inputting or injecting malformed data.
In this scenario, the company has not lost data from malformed data inputted into a database.
External scans focus on viewing devices and services from the "outside" of the network. Not enough
information is in this scenario to determine if this was the root cause.
Question 4 Incorrect
10/17/26, 6:21 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 4/10
You are building a PowerShell script that includes creating a file, writing content into the file,
and then display the file contents on the screen.
Which of the following PowerShell cmdlets will you need to use to perform these tasks?
A New-Item Correct
B Get-Content Correct
C Set-Location
D Add-Content Correct
E Rename-Item
F Move-Item
G Get-Location
Explanation
You will need to use the following PowerShell cmdlets to perform these tasks:
New-Item: Creates a file.
Add-Content: Writes content into the file.
Get-Content: Displays the file contents on the screen.
The remainder of the listed PowerShell cmdlets perform the following tasks:
Rename-Item: Renames an existing file.
Set-Location: Changes the current directory.
Move-Item: Moves a file to another directory.
Get-Location: Displays the current directory on the screen.
Question 5 Incorrect
10/17/26, 6:21 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 5/10
You want to display the following text on a command line from a shell script:
Watermelons cost $6.99 today only!
Which of the following commands would you use to make sure the text is displayed?
A echo Watermelons cost $6.99 today only!
B echo --Watermelons cost $6.99 today only!--
C echo /Watermelons cost $6.99 today only!/
D echo "Watermelons cost $6.99 today only!" Correct
Explanation
You would use the echo "Watermelons cost $6.99 today only!" command as the dollar sign ($) is a
metacharacter and needs to be recognized as text. You can use single quotes, double quotes or a
backslash to indicate that the dollar sign is text, otherwise only Watermelons cost would be returned.
Using forward slashes (/) or double dashes (--) would not indicate that the dollar sign is being used as
text (instead of a metacharacter).
Question 6 Incorrect
10/17/26, 6:21 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 6/10
A team of software developers at a large corporation need to exchange data between multiple
systems. The data needs to be easily readable and writable by both systems and able to
handle complex data structures.
Which of the following data interchange formats would be the most appropriate for the
software developers to use in this scenario?
A Yet Another Markup Language (YAML)
B Comma-Separated Values (CSV)
C eXtensible Markup Language (XML) Correct
D JavaScript Object Notation (JSON)
Explanation
eXtensible Markup Language (XML) provides a flexible and powerful way to store and exchange complex
data structures, making it an ideal choice for software developers.
JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) provides a simple and efficient representation of data. However, JSON
may need help handling complex data structures and eXtensible Markup Language (XML).
Comma-Separated Values (CSV) are easy to read and write. However, they have limited ability to store
complex data structures and may not be an appropriate choice for software developers.
Yet Another Markup Language (YAML) is a more human-readable alternative to JavaScript Object
Notation (JSON).
Question 7 Incorrect
10/17/26, 6:21 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 7/10
A software developer at a technology company needs to store and exchange data between
two systems. The data needs to be easily readable and writable by both systems, and it needs
to be lightweight and efficient to transmit over the network.
Which of the following data interchange formats should the developer use?
A Comma-Separated Values (CSV)
B JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Correct
C Yet Another Markup Language (YAML)
D eXtensible Markup Language (XML)
Explanation
JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) is a lightweight data-interchange format that is easy to read and write
by both humans and machines.
eXtensible Markup Language (XML) provides a flexible and powerful way to store and exchange complex
data structures. However, XML is more verbose than JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) and not as
efficient for transmitting data over the network.
While Yet Another Markup Language (YAML) is a more human-readable alternative to JavaScript Object
Notation (JSON), it is not an efficient choice for transmitting data over the network.
While Comma-Separated Values (CSV) are easy to read and write, they have limited ability to store
complex data structures. A CSV file is not an efficient choice for transmitting data over the network.
Question 8 Incorrect
10/17/26, 6:21 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 8/10
You have just finished creating a game script in nano that allows a user to try and guess a
number (fixed variable) that you have provided.
The script looks like the following:
#!/bin/bash
mynum=25
while :
do
echo "Enter a number or <CTRL+C> to quit"read num1if [ $num1 -gt $mynum ]; thenecho
"Your number is bigger"echoelif [ $num1 -lt $mynum ]; thenecho "Your number is
smaller"echoelseecho "We picked the same number!"echofi
done
Based on this script, which of the following scripting tools did you use to make sure the user
is able to repeat the game without leaving the script and starting it again?
A Dynamic variable
B Echo
C Fixed variable
D While loop Correct
Explanation
In order to make sure that the user can continue playing the game without exiting the script, you
utilized a while loop structure in the script with the while command and if/elif/else. While variables and
the echo command are being used, they do not contribute to creating a loop in the script structure.
The mynum=25 command line sets your number to compare against the numbers provided by the user.
The read num1 command sets the value for the $num1 variable provided by the user. The If [ $num1 -
gt $mynum ]; then command compares the user number to your set number to see if it is greater than
your number. And the while : command sets the loop for allowing the user to continue playing until they
exit the game by pressing Ctrl+C to quit.
Question 9 Incorrect
10/17/26, 6:21 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 9/10
A company has just experienced a ransomware attack resulting from employees' credentials
being used by a remote attacker after being compromised by technical means.
The incident response team needs to provide recommendations in the incident report for
improving the organization's cybersecurity posture.
Which of the following recommendations would be the MOST effective?
A Implementing multi-factor authentication Correct
B Running regular vulnerability scans
C Upgrading the firewall software
D Conducting security awareness training for employees
Explanation
Multi-factor authentication is a critical security measure that can prevent unauthorized access to
systems and data. This recommendation can help the organization strengthen its security posture and
prevent future attacks.
Although upgrading firewall software can help to protect against external threats, it would not have
prevented the credential compromise that led to the ransomware attack.
There is no indication that regular vulnerability scanning would have stopped the attack, which is best
against misconfigurations and outdated software. The best recommendation is to implement multifactor authentication.
Security awareness training can help protect against social engineering attacks, but it may not be
sufficient to prevent credential compromises caused by technical means.
